At the start of each year, Abdul invests $300 in a savings account that pays compound interest at a rate
of 4% per year.
At the end of 2 years:
•
there is $300 which has been in the account for 2 years
•
there is $300 which has been in the account for 1 year
•
interest is paid on each of these amounts.
Work out the total amount of money Abdul has in the account at the end of 2 years.
............................................................. [3]
